hero.title: Connect with Your Community
hero.subtitle: Go Touch Grass bridges volunteers and local needs across small-town Japan.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Residents, businesses, and organisations post volunteer opportunities with location, time, and skills needed.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Volunteers browse nearby opportunities, filter by skill and schedule, and apply with a message.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our AI agent reviews applicants, scores matches, and helps requesters confirm the best fit.

opportunities.title: Volunteer Opportunities
opportunities.intro: Browse nearby volunteer tasks. This side is for volunteers who want to find something to join.

discovery.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, category, task, or location
discovery.mapPlaceholderBody: Pins will appear here after the project connects event latitude and longitude from the database.
discovery.noMatchingBody: Try broadening the search, clearing a filter, or checking another date window.

location.title: Location
location.heading: Plan the trip before applying
location.body: The map opens with this destination pre-filled. If details change, the organizer will update the address before confirmation.

cards.title: Task cards
cards.heading: Choose the part that fits your energy
cards.body: Each task includes its effort level, working style, remaining places, and the practical details needed before applying.

task.title: Choose your task
task.multiple: You can select more than one task for this event.
task.single: Select one concrete role for this event.

time.title: Confirm the time
time.conflict: You have another active application around this time. You can still submit.
time.confirm: I understand the time commitment for the selected task.

skills.title: Skills and experience
skills.notePlaceholder: Relevant experience, comfort level, or notes for the organizer

summary.title: Review your application
summary.waitlistNotice: This will place you on the waitlist, not confirm your spot yet.

success.waitlistNext: The organizer can confirm you if a spot opens.
success.pendingNext: The organizer will review and confirm your spot.

new.title: Post an Opportunity
new.intro: Create a request for volunteers. This side is for employers, organizers, and local groups.

placeholders.title: e.g. Help clean the community garden
placeholders.description: Describe the work, schedule, location, and what volunteers should know.

application.title: Apply to Volunteer
application.messagePlaceholder: Tell the requester why you're a great fit…

requester.title: Requester Dashboard
requester.intro: Review your posted opportunities and keep an eye on incoming applicants.
requester.empty: Posted opportunities will appear here after you publish or save one.

volunteer.title: Volunteer Dashboard
volunteer.intro: Track every activity you applied for, with status, schedule, location, and task details.
volunteer.noPast: Past activities will be shown here after they finish.
volunteer.calendarEmpty: No applications scheduled in this month.
volunteer.recommendedIntro: Your profile and application history can be used for recommendations as more matching logic is added.

auth.signInTitle: Sign in to Go Touch Grass
auth.volunteerSignInIntro: Use this entrance to find opportunities and apply as a volunteer.
auth.requesterSignInIntro: Use this entrance to post needs and manage volunteer opportunities.
auth.accountTypeLabel: What kind of account do you want to create?
auth.volunteerAccountTypeDescription: Find activities and apply to join.
auth.volunteerRegisterNote: You are creating a volunteer account for browsing and applying to opportunities.
auth.requesterRegisterNote: You are creating an employer account for posting volunteer opportunities.
auth.noAccount: Sign in or create an account to continue.

profile.volunteerSetupIntro: Tell the platform what you are interested in, where you are, and when you can usually help.
profile.requesterSetupIntro: Set up your organizer profile so volunteers can understand who is hosting the opportunity and what kind of environment they can expect.
profile.volunteerEditIntro: Update your volunteer details so future recommendations and applications fit you better.
profile.requesterEditIntro: Update your organizer profile so volunteers understand your group and location.
profile.becomeRequesterBody: Your current account is set up for volunteering. To post a need, add an employer profile to this same account. Your volunteer profile will stay available.
profile.becomeVolunteerBody: Your current account is set up for posting needs. To apply for opportunities, add a volunteer profile to this same account. Your employer profile will stay available.

fields.name: Display name
fields.certificationStatusPrivate: This status is controlled by platform review and is not publicly shown until approved.
fields.isLocationPublic: Allow organization location to be shown publicly
fields.antiSocialForcesConfirmed: I confirm this organizer is not associated with anti-social forces.
fields.termsAccepted: I agree to the platform terms, privacy handling, and activity responsibility policy.

placeholders.activitySpaceSize: e.g. small room for 8 people, outdoor garden, gymnasium

public.title: Public organizer profile
public.description: This information helps volunteers understand who is hosting the activity and whether the environment feels trustworthy.

review.title: Responsible person information
review.description: This section is private. It is used only for platform review, emergency contact, and safety checks, and is not shown to volunteers by default.

certification.title: Legal or group certification
certification.description: This section appears only when the organizer type is a group or legal entity. Add details that can later be checked against official records or reviewed manually.
